name: openbb_economy_gdp
description:
Nominal GDP for a country through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.gdp.nominal).
Returns: {country, provider, data_points, truncated, gdp_data: [records with date, country, value]} or {country, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (e.g. united_states, germany; default united_states); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (econdb, oecd; default oecd).
US real GDP: av_gdp, fred_gdp; growth: fred_gdp_growth. Keys: econdb, oecd need none.
Example: {"country": "germany"}

country.description: Country, lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, japan

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
